authority: Frontend-observable pricing, rule, promotion, breakdown and drift behavior. Exact HTTP operationIds remain bound only from the pinned canonical OpenAPI at F0.2.
prohibitions: No frontend, SSR loader/action, hook, store or component recalculates prices, taxes, FX, discounts, commissions, rounding or promotion budgets.
No frontend infers hidden tenant commercial lines from public totals.
No client supplies a trusted pipeline stage, price signature, tax result, FX snapshot, promotion reservation state or booking channel.
No missing OpenAPI operation or response field may be invented from this presentation contract.

price_result.decimal_fields: Strings only; never parse through JavaScript number.
price_result.reconciliation: Visible projected lines and totals must reconcile exactly as returned. The UI may group lines but never changes signed amounts.
price_result.signature_display: Show a shortened copyable reference to authorized tenant users; do not expose signature internals to public consumers.

rules: A published version is read-only; edit forks a draft.
Validate returns field, cross-field and ordering diagnostics without publishing.
Preview compares current published and candidate results using representative inputs.
Publish requires explicit confirmation of affected scopes and signature-version consequences.
Stale revision never auto-merges or auto-retries a publish.

promotions.budget_display: Server-returned reserved/consumed/remaining count and amount facts with last-updated/revision; the UI never predicts a successful reservation.

rules: Search, offer, quote, booking, amendment and cancellation display server-calculated results from the same evaluator.
Every offer/quote/booking price uses one reusable breakdown component with principal projection.
Revalidation compares signatures and renders added, removed and changed lines plus rate/rule/promotion/FX/tax reasons.
Acceptance of price drift is an explicit server mutation with actor/time evidence; closing a dialog is not acceptance.
Cancellation/refund views render reversal/allocation lines from the original snapshot and do not recompute historical price locally.

failure_presentations.PRICING_INPUT_INCOMPLETE: Field/page validation summary; preserve the draft and focus the first actionable issue.
failure_presentations.PRICING_POLICY_INVALID: Structured policy diagnostics; do not offer publish.
failure_presentations.PRICING_EFFECT_CONFLICT: Show conflicting effect/group references and simulation trace.
failure_presentations.PRICING_CONFIG_STALE: Show current version and candidate version; require reload, compare and explicit retry.
failure_presentations.PRICING_PIPELINE_VERSION_UNSUPPORTED: Terminal compatibility state with refresh/support action; never approximate a price.
failure_presentations.PROMOTION_INVALID: Show a non-enumerating eligibility reason appropriate to the principal.
failure_presentations.PROMOTION_BUDGET_EXCEEDED: Remove the benefit through server revalidation and show a price-drift decision if total changed.
failure_presentations.FX_RATE_UNAVAILABLE: Retryable only when the canonical error says so; never substitute 1.0.
failure_presentations.TAX_POLICY_INVALID: Tenant authoring diagnostic; public views receive the canonical safe message.
failure_presentations.TAX_POLICY_UNAVAILABLE: Block price acceptance/booking and preserve recoverable state.
failure_presentations.ROUNDING_POLICY_INVALID: Tenant authoring diagnostic; do not round in the UI.
failure_presentations.PRICE_CHANGED: Render the canonical structural diff and require explicit acceptance.

mandatory_mock_matrix: all twelve stages with deterministic skipped reasons
tenant/agent/consumer projections over the same signed result
stay-pay plus promotion plus mandatory charge
markup plus commission plus nationality adjustment
unchanged and structurally changed price signatures
English, Arabic RTL, Thai, long-text, keyboard, screen-reader and narrow viewport
